runtime: The extension bridges settings to the real provider in a managed pinned Tracker tab. Ordinary Tracker tabs can close; the browser must remain running.
distribution: Unsigned browser packages, as requested. No store listings or signing credentials exist yet. Firefox developer loading is temporary.
limits: One explicitly enrolled room plus independent global contribution per extension profile.
Browser shutdown, sleep, offline periods and eviction interrupt availability. No 24-hour observation is claimed.
Firefox native acceptance covers temporary installation/add-on reload; Chromium additionally covers a complete browser restart.
